title: Moving a group member by its own id does nothing
task: Move an element that belongs to a placed group. ElementTransformUtils.MoveElement on the member's own ElementId silently has no effect; move the group instance instead, or ungroup first.

pitfalls.symptom: MoveElement(doc, memberId, translation) returns with no warning or error, and nothing moved.
pitfalls.cause: Revit ignores a move addressed to a group member's own id while it is in the group (observed live; the reason is not documented).
pitfalls.fix: Move the group's ElementId (rigid-body move of the instance), or MoveElements with the group id plus member ids; to move one member alone, ungroup first.

provenance.ref: revit/test-harness/phase_a_test.go TestPhaseACoreCRUDAndQuery/EditGroupPropagatesToAllInstances (from the test comment; the subtest does not exercise this path)
